title: Prepositions of Place: at / in / on
grammarTitle: Prepositions of Place: at / in / on
grammarNote: "At", "in" и "on" — самые частые предлоги места в английском. Хотя они все переводятся как "в", "на" или "у", их употребление следует чётким правилам. AT — точная позиция (адрес, место назначения). IN — внутри ограниченного пространства (комнаты, города, страны). ON — на поверхности или линии (этаж, улица, берег).

grammarTable.subject: AT
grammarTable.example: "at the bus stop / at the mosque / at number 12 / at the corner"

grammarTable.subject: AT
grammarTable.example: "at the university / at home / at work / at a concert / at the library"

grammarTable.subject: IN
grammarTable.example: "in the room / in the building / in the city / in Kazakhstan / in the car"

grammarTable.subject: IN
grammarTable.example: "in Uralsk / in Russia / in the centre of the city / in the north"

grammarTable.subject: ON
grammarTable.example: "on the table / on the wall / on the floor / on the desk"

grammarTable.subject: ON
grammarTable.example: "on Dostyq Avenue / on the river / on the left / on the second floor"

rows.example: "She lives at 47 Dostyq Avenue." / "Meet me at number 12."
"I'm at the bus stop." / "She's at the library." / "He's at the mosque."
"She studies at WKU." / "He works at the hospital." / "I'm at a meeting."
"I'll be at home this evening." / "He's at work until 6."
"She's in the library." (inside the building) / "The café is in the main building."
"He lives in Uralsk." / "They study in Kazakhstan." / "She grew up in Almaty."
"She's in the car." / "I was in the taxi for twenty minutes."
"The campus is in the north of the city." / "It's in the centre."
"The book is on the desk." / "The map is on the wall." / "Sit on the chair."
"The library is on the second floor." / "The café is on the ground floor."
"The university is on Dostyq Avenue." / "There's a shop on that street."
"The bank is on the left." / "There's a park on the right." / "On the corner."
"I'll meet you at the library." (to visit/use it — at = destination)
"She's in the library studying." (inside the building)
"I'm in the bus." (you are inside it)
"I'm on the bus." (you are travelling by bus)
"The café is on the corner." (at the junction/turn of two streets)
"I'm standing at the corner of Dostyq and Lenin Street."

grammarTip:
AT / IN / ON — три ключевых значения:
① AT = точка назначения / конкретное место / событие:
"at the bus stop / at home / at WKU / at the corner"
② IN = внутри ограниченного пространства / города / страны:
"in the room / in Uralsk / in Kazakhstan / in the car"
③ ON = на поверхности / на улице / на этаже:
"on the desk / on Dostyq Avenue / on the second floor / on the left"

💡 Часто путают:
"I'm ON the bus" (еду на автобусе) vs "I'm IN the bus" (нахожусь внутри)
"in the library" (я внутри здания) vs "at the library" (я пришёл в библиотеку)

exercises.text: The pharmacy is ___ the corner of the main square.
exercises.hint: "on the corner" = at the junction of two streets. "The pharmacy is ON the corner." ✅
"at WKU" (specific institution) + "in Uralsk" (city). "She studies AT WKU IN Uralsk." ✅

exercises.text: The library is ___ the second floor of the main building.
exercises.hint: "on the second floor" — floors use "on". "The library is ON the second floor." ✅

exercises.instruction: Choose: "in the bus" or "on the bus"?
exercises.text: "I'm ___ the bus — should be at the stop in five minutes."
exercises.hint: "on the bus" = travelling by bus. "I'm ON the bus." (not "in the bus" — unless you're describing being physically inside it as an object)

exercises.text: The café is ___ Dostyq Avenue, ___ the left side of the street.
exercises.hint: "on Dostyq Avenue" (street) + "on the left side". Both use "on". ✅

exercises.text: She's ___ the library right now — she went there to study.
exercises.hint: "in the library" = inside the building. "She's IN the library." (physically inside) ✅

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct preposition for a country.
exercises.text: I grew up ___ Kazakhstan and now I study ___ Uralsk.
exercises.hint: Countries and cities both use "in". "I grew up IN Kazakhstan. I study IN Uralsk." ✅

exercises.text: She is ___ home, not ___ work. She has a meeting ___ the university tomorrow.
exercises.hint: "at home / at work / at the university" — all fixed expressions using "at". ✅

exercises.text: The ATM is ___ the main building — just inside the entrance.
exercises.hint: "in the main building" = inside the building. "The ATM is IN the main building." ✅

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct preposition for an event.
exercises.text: I met her ___ a linguistics conference last year.
exercises.hint: "at a conference" = attending an event. "I met her AT a conference." ✅ (events use "at")

exercises.text: The university is ___ the north of the city, ___ Dostyq Avenue.
exercises.hint: "in the north of the city" (area) + "on Dostyq Avenue" (street). ✅
"at + number + street" = precise address. "She lives AT 47 Dostyq Avenue." ✅

questions.text: "She's ___ home right now." Choose the correct preposition.
questions.hint: "at home" is a fixed expression. "She's AT home." ✅

questions.text: "The café is ___ the corner of the street."
questions.hint: "on the corner" = located at the junction of two streets. ✅
"in" = country or large area. "I was born IN Kazakhstan." ✅
"at" + institution, "in" + city. "She studies AT WKU IN Uralsk." ✅
"on" + street/avenue name. "The university is ON Dostyq Avenue." ✅
"on the bus" = travelling by bus. "on" for using transport as a service. ✅
"in the building" = physically inside. "The ATM is IN the main building." ✅

questions.text: "I met her ___ a conference last year." (event)
questions.hint: "at" + event. "I met her AT a conference." ✅

questions.text: "The pharmacy is ___ the corner, ___ the left."
questions.hint: "on the corner" + "on the left". Both use "on". ✅

questions.text: "She grew up ___ a small town ___ western Kazakhstan."
questions.hint: "in a small town" (area) + "in western Kazakhstan" (area). Both use "in". ✅
"at the hospital" = works there as a destination/institution. "He works AT the hospital." ✅
"on the wall" = attached to/on the surface of. "The map is ON the wall." ✅

questions.text: "I'll meet you ___ the bus stop ___ 8 a.m."
questions.hint: "at the bus stop" (specific point) + "at 8 a.m." (specific time — at for time too). ✅
"in her room" = enclosed space, inside. "She's IN her room." ✅

questions.text: What is the main difference between "at" and "in" with a building?
opts: "At" = going there as a destination; "in" = inside it
questions.correct: "At" = going there as a destination; "in" = inside it
questions.hint: "at the library" = going there as a place. "in the library" = physically inside. Both are common and correct.
